name: Toronto Pearson International Airport

runway.quote: Runway 05-23 measures 3,390 x 61 metres (11,120 x 200 feet)

curfew.v: Restricted hours 00:30-06:29 local: every arrival or departure needs the GTAA's express permission (Transport Canada night flight budget); medevac allowed with prior RMU approval; no extensions for Chapter 2 or non-noise-certificated aircraft. Day-of requests by phone to the GTAA RMU; written requests up to 30 days ahead
curfew.quote: Operations at Toronto Pearson International Airport are restricted between the hours of 00:30 and 06:29 local. ... Air Operators planning to arrive or depart within the restricted hours must have the express permission of the GTAA

noise.v: Chapter 2 aircraft may operate only 07:00 to midnight; all engine run-ups need GTAA pre-approval
noise.quote: they're only permitted to operate from 7:00 am until midnight

slots.v: General and business aviation flights need a reservation from the GTAA Airport Reservation Office, through the OCS portal or an FBO. First come, first served. Requests open 72 hours before the flight (30 days for YYZ-based GA/BA tenants). Since 21 Oct 2025 the flight must operate within 30 minutes either side of the booked time
slots.quote: all GA/BA operations must occur within +/- 30 minutes of the booking reservation.

hours.v: Normal general and business aviation hours 06:30-00:29 local; 00:30-06:29 local falls under the Night Flight Program (see curfew)
hours.quote: during the normal operating hours of 0630-0029 local YYZ.

permits.v: Canadian Transportation Agency: non-scheduled international services to and from Canada are licensed by the Agency (exemptions to the licence duty exist; that notice was not read). For a licensed airline with aircraft under 15,900 kg MCTOW, no charter permit, notices or reports, except a foreign licensee flying between Canada and a country other than its home country, which must apply for a charter permit. At 15,900 kg or more the rule depends on route and passengers or goods; check the CTA guide. Guide page last modified 14 Dec 2020
permits.quote: you do not have to apply for a charter permit or send us any notices or reports.

deicing.v: de-icing and anti-icing only at the Airport Central Deicing Facility (or other places the GTAA specifies and approves); a Glycol Mitigation Plan is required
deicing.quote: Deicing and Anti-icing must occur only at the Airport Central Deicing Facility

fuel.v: all aircraft fuelling by GTAA-licensed providers and trained staff; no fuelling with engines running unless the GTAA authorises it in writing; the rules name no fuel types or suppliers
fuel.quote: All Aircraft fueling operations must be conducted by GTAA-licensed providers
